title: Bring your Designs to Life in Unreal Engine with LiveSync 2
content:
## _Hey creators,_

We are excited to announce that **CLO LiveSync 2.0.0 has just been released** for CLO 2025.0! MD LiveSync 2.0.0 will be available when MD 2025.0 is released. 

What's new in LiveSync 2.0.0? The UI and workflow have been reworked to shorten the process of bringing Marvelous CLOthes to Unreal Engine, and support for macOS has been finally added! 

![d94dc12fab5e440d8ec345b468d113bd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/ab037770b24049bd9426486574a4e1fc/images/d94dc12fab5e440d8ec345b468d113bdlivesync2-promo-image.png)

content_description: Announcing the release of CLO LiveSync 2.0.0 for CLO 2025.0, featuring a redesigned UI, faster workflow, and new macOS support to streamline Marvelous CLOthes integration with Unreal Engine.

title: Fabrics colliding with each other
content:
Hi, so this has been a problem of mine quite a while  
When I want to layer garments, it seems that the fabric of the shirts 'clash' with fabric of the jacket. making both garments unstable and moving frantically.

I have tried layering, freezing the garments, but it all the same. can anyone help me?

![d06177d3b28146c1ac843f6499a8e83c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/6fc614ccfbb94ad4bd5fc84927c96f27/images/d06177d3b28146c1ac843f6499a8e83cScreenshot%202025-04-11%20140019.png)

![075f8bd5c4a74c9aa00a67d83aa9b9d9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/6fc614ccfbb94ad4bd5fc84927c96f27/images/075f8bd5c4a74c9aa00a67d83aa9b9d9Screenshot%202025-04-11%20140033.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: This is an issue with the fabric not fitting under the arm pit. The T-pose helps while creating the outfit but doesn’t help when you have to move everything to the final pose so what I do is lower the avatar skin offset. It’s set to 3mm as default. Lower this to 1mm. Then for the fabric offset lower this also. This will allow more fabric is a tighter space under the arm. If this doesn’t fix it I sometimes decrease the bicep circumference or nudge the shoulders out a little.

Comment 2: Hi, I would advise to work with the avatar's default T-pose first when building and sewing your garments. In your screenshots, the arms are too close with the body, which is why the fabrics are colliding with each other and the avatar.
content_description: A community forum page aimed at seeking advice and solutions for preventing fabric slipping and instability when layering garments.

title: Lines or points are too close together
content:
Hey all  
  
I'm running into an issue when grading where I can't switch between sizes because I'm receiving the error message, "Lines or points are too close together. Please move the points further away from each other."  
  
The problem is that there is no instruction as to which points are too close. I've deleted a number of points but deleting more would change the characteristics of curves etc.   
  
Any advice how to solve? 

Thanks

![8109e1ee76a045948a48071def92955a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/b125020a8cee42ad902c21fd7ce258f3/images/8109e1ee76a045948a48071def92955aPoints%20too%20close%20-%20Combats.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Found the issue in the new version of CLO. It was in the waistband, the points weren't close to the eye, but when the grading occured, the second black dot on the bottom edge became too close to other points.

Comment 2: It looks like there are two points really close together at the top edge of that white middle pocket. Is that causing the issue?

Comment 3: Not sure but I would suggest to look closely at corners, sometimes there are close points that we can't see from a standard distance. Like on my screenshot, there are actually 2 points.
Reply 1: Thanks Lucile, I'll take a look. Would be a great feature for CLO to highlight where the issue is!
content_description: A community forum page seeking advice on resolving an error about overlapping points during grading without clear guidance on which points to adjust.

title: Animation Export Issue (ABC, FBX)
content:
I'm trying to apply one of CLO’s default motion files to the default female avatar and export it to work in another program (like Blender or C4D). I exported the avatar as an FBX file, but no matter which motion file I apply in CLO, the animation only imports up to frame 26 in both Blender and C4D.

If I export as an ABC (Alembic) file, the full animation plays correctly in both programs — but since Alembic files don’t carry UV data, it creates problems with texturing. That’s why I would prefer to export using FBX.

I remember FBX exports working fine in the past, but now it seems like something has changed. Is this a known issue?

I've attached screenshots of my FBX export settings in CLO and the import settings in Blender. The motion file I applied has a total of **577 frames** , but again, only **26 frames** are imported into Blender and C4D. I’ve also confirmed that the **Scene Time Warp** in CLO is properly set to **1** , so that shouldn’t be causing the issue.

Is there currently a bug or known issue preventing full animation export through FBX?  
Or is it inherently difficult to export full motion via FBX from CLO, and ABC is the only reliable option?

Is there any way to fix this?

I’d really appreciate any solution or workaround.

my CLO3D version : 2024.2.344

![e07d40c832644017a7ae74fd11263891](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/fd8623731787430dbdfb3a29cb2584d3/images/e07d40c832644017a7ae74fd112638912.png)

![c64b4fa807cd41f794ab306c86beeca5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/fd8623731787430dbdfb3a29cb2584d3/images/c64b4fa807cd41f794ab306c86beeca51.png)

![49b52dbb3723494f8e4ec08ad685e5e9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/fd8623731787430dbdfb3a29cb2584d3/images/49b52dbb3723494f8e4ec08ad685e5e93.png)

title: How to Enjoy the AR Filter: Get Cuter or Funnier 😂✨
content:
Hey creators,

Are you interested in AR filters? Or do you think they've already peaked?  
If that's the case, then pay attention now! 

Create moments that are cuter and more fun than you ever imagined with AR outfits. This AR filter can be worn by anyone, from babies to adults, so experiment with your own style! 🤭💥

Try out styles you can play around with, from trendy clothes to popular meme outfits. Put on the latest fashion or surprise your friends with a laugh-inducing meme outfit! 😎👗

# **👶 Cute Version?**

We tried this AR filter on babies, and it was too cute! The little ones look absolutely adorable in their hip-hop outfits!

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N1uv8y8oQgo?start=0

  


# **🤣 Funny Version?**

But when we applied the filter to an aerobics-dressed guy? A totally different vibe! It turned into a fun vibe that had everyone laughing! 😂 You wouldn’t believe how much one filter can change the vibe!

![2944b2fbb2f44e2788ea8243d137cbdc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/03a603ec73524b37b5176dd069041e16/images/2944b2fbb2f44e2788ea8243d137cbdcapply.png)

  


# **💡 How to Use the AR Filter**

1️⃣ Scan the QR code above. (You can use Snapchat or TikTok apps.)  
2️⃣ When the camera opens, select the filter.  
3️⃣ Try on a virtual outfit on your smartphone screen!  
4️⃣ Take a photo or video and share it on our community page or social media!

# **💡 Tips for Use!**

✔️ Upload your photos or videos to Social Media and share them with your friends!  
✔️ Try different poses to find your unique style!  
✔️ Experiment with cute or funny versions to create different looks!

# **🎨 Want to Create Your Own?**

Would you like to create your own filter? We already have a Snapchat AR filter tutorial ready for you, [so check it out!](https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/9431689555343-Tutorials)

And the best part? We're also working on a **TikTok** tutorial, so stay tuned!🎥🔥 

If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment! 😊

  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/03a603ec73524b37b5176dd069041e16/images/7ab643faa62d4c03b05bef017f38e8f9thumb.png)
